_note: Stars for the intro (card INTRO-1). Twenty four fixed points in the 256x240 frame, grouped into shapes a Greek myth reader will see: a sickle (9), a thunderbolt (7), a trident at the right edge (3), a bident (2) and three loose ones. Each point is the star's centre pixel; the game draws the 5x5 star sprite centred on it. Positions are inside x 4..252 and y 8..160 so no star is cut by the frame edge and all of them sit in the sky, never over the text crawl area below y 128.

shapes.name: sickle
shapes.meaning: the reaping blade Kronos used, and the shape of the moon it left

shapes.name: thunderbolt
shapes.meaning: the bolt of the sky father, zigzagged down the middle of the frame

shapes.name: trident
shapes.meaning: the sea god's three points, standing at the right edge of the sky

shapes.name: bident
shapes.meaning: the two pointed fork of the underworld
